## Introduction

This is the R companion vignette showing the equivalent RPadrino workflow.
The [RPadrino](https://github.com/padrinoDB/RPadrino) package provides
access to the PADRINO database of published Integral Projection Models.

```{r}
#| message: false
library(Rpadrino)
library(ipmr)
```

## Downloading the Database

```{r}
pdb <- pdb_download(save = FALSE)
cat("Models in database:", nrow(pdb$Metadata), "\n")
cat("Unique species:", length(unique(pdb$Metadata$species_accepted)), "\n")
```

## Exploring the Database

```{r}
# Species names
species <- pdb_species_accepted(pdb)
head(species, 10)
```

```{r}
# Citations
pdb_citations(pdb, ipm_id = "aaa310")
```

## Building a Simple Deterministic Model

```{r}
# Two-step approach
proto <- pdb_make_proto_ipm(pdb, ipm_id = "aaa310")
ipm <- pdb_make_ipm(proto)

# Get lambda
lam <- lambda(ipm)
cat("aaa310 λ =", lam$aaa310, "\n")
```

## Batch Analysis

```{r}
# Build multiple models
ids <- pdb$Metadata$ipm_id[1:20]
protos <- pdb_make_proto_ipm(pdb, ipm_id = ids)
ipms <- pdb_make_ipm(protos)
cat("Successfully built:", length(ipms), "/ 20\n")
```

```{r}
# Compute lambda for each
lambdas <- lambda(ipms)
for (id in names(lambdas)) {
  cat(" ", id, ": λ =", round(lambdas[[id]], 4), "\n")
}
```

## Subsetting

```{r}
sub_pdb <- pdb_subset(pdb, ipm_ids = c("aaa310", "aaa341"))
cat("Models in subset:", nrow(sub_pdb$Metadata), "\n")
pdb_species_accepted(sub_pdb)
```

## Saving and Loading

```{r}
#| eval: false
pdb_save(pdb, destination = "/tmp/padrino_data/")
pdb2 <- pdb_load("/tmp/padrino_data/")
```
